title: Halloween Cookie Challenge
description:
S02 E04 — Halloween Slice and Bake and 3D Haunted Mirror
Four cookie makers take on one of the hardest technical challenges: slice and bake cookies; hosts Duff Goldman and Rosanna Pansino reflect on the remaining three bakers' cracking 3D haunted mirrors, each with something spooky trapped inside.

title: Halloween Top 20
description: Traveling coast to coast to cover some of the spooky attractions that All Hallows' Eve has to offer.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S01 E01 — 7 Deadly Jack-o'-Lanterns
Seven carvers must master the classic jack-o'-lantern; in the Quick Carve round, the competitors depict the struggle between good and evil; in the Big Carve round, each competitor is given one of the seven deadly sins to inspire their masterpiece.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S01 E02 — Trick-or-Treating Nightmare
Six pumpkin carvers tackle 3D sculpting challenges, starting with science experiments gone wrong in the Quick Carve round; things heat up in the Big Carve round when the competitors incorporate fire in 3D dioramas of trick-or-treating pumpkins.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S01 E03 — Zombie Beasts
Five expert pumpkin carvers face a spooky-structures challenge; the carvers stack pumpkins to create undead animals in a pet cemetery-themed Quick Carve round before moving on to make enormous prehistoric creatures in the Big Carve round.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S01 E04 — Giant Monster Bash
The final four pumpkin carvers create terrifying monsters-in-law and larger-than-life monster party scenes using Atlantic Giant pumpkins; the winning carver will take home the $25,000 prize and bragging rights.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S02 E01 — Jack-o'-Lantern Face-Off
Jack-o'-lanterns are the name of the game as Alyson Hannigan challenges the seven carvers to create a cursed nursery rhyme triptych and a spooky underwater display.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S02 E02 — Hungry Hungry Pumpkins
Host Alyson Hannigan challenges the six competitors to create intricately carved 3D facial expressions and foods; the sweetest carvers get to stay, but judges Marc Evan and Terri Hardin give one carver the sour news to go home.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S02 E03 — Out of This World
The five carvers have to create sky-high alien encounters using at least two stacked pumpkins, then host Alyson Hannigan challenges them to use at least 15 pumpkins to create an epic monster ride for judges Marc Evan and Terri Hardin.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S02 E04 — 30 Seconds to Doomsday
In the finale, the remaining four carvers are challenged to create a doomsday hero and then incorporate that character into a 5-foot-tall scene depicting the end of the world and featuring world-famous Atlantic giant pumpkins.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E01 — Giant Jacks
Host Sunny Anderson asks seven carvers to create massive jack-o'-lanterns that tell a ghost story; then, each carver must create four nesting jack-o'-lanterns that are just as enchanting on their own as they are when they come together.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E02 — Scary Sculpting
Each of the six carvers sculpt a 3D zombie in their likeness, complete with accessories that reflect their personality; the first team challenge requires creating a giant haunted house using a minimum of 15 pumpkins.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E03 — Sky-High Scares
Sunny challenges the carvers to reach new heights and build their biggest pumpkin creations yet, first bringing a frightening phobia to life and then depicting a circus sideshow gone terribly wrong.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E04 — Gourd Games
The final four carvers battle it out to earn the title of "Outrageous Pumpkins Champion"; they create a larger-than-life children's toy with a creepy spin; then, the carvers go all out with a sinister depiction of a popular playground pastime.

title: Freakshow Cakes
description:
S01 E01 — Creepy Clowns
Three teams of bakers create clown cakes that will haunt the dreams of kids and adults alike; in addition to the creep-out clown cakes, Vivian Chan and Zac Young challenge the bakers to create concession stand sideshow treats.

title: Freakshow Cakes
description:
S01 E02 — Snake Charmer Showdown
Vivian Chan and Zac Young challenge the three teams of bakers to imagine a dangerous snake charming gone wrong; in addition, each team must bake a sideshow sweet treat with a surprise inside to complement their jaw-dropping snake cake.

title: Freakshow Cakes
description:
S01 E03 — Misfortune Teller
Three teams of bakers create mystical fortune teller cakes, but in this big top of horrors, the crystal ball only reveals tragedy and disaster; teams also create a shocking sideshow sweet to complement their main act.

title: Freakshow Cakes
description:
S01 E04 — Flame Show
Three teams of bakers design smokin' hot cakes inspired by the infamous fire breather; Vivian Chan and Zac Young also challenge them to present a fiery sideshow sweet to go with their dangerous cake displays.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S01 E01 — Witches & Scary Places
Five teams create enticing Halloween themed displays of a witch and haunted house that scares.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S01 E02 — Scary Tales
Four teams display a twisted version of a fairy tale; one team is eliminated.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Zombies vs. Vampires
There are three teams remaining which present a battle display between zombies and vampires.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S01 E04 — Underworld
Two teams create Halloween displays of the Underworld; choosing the "Halloween Wars" champion.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S02 E01 — Evil Clowns
Five teams must create a terrifying clown; one team is out.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S02 E02 — Battle of the Vampire Killer
Teams capture a battle in which a vampire killer slays a vampire.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Science Gone Wrong
Teams must capture the moment when a mad scientist's creation goes wrong.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S02 E04 — Zombie Wedding
Teams Recreate a romantic yet horrific zombie wedding.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S03 E01 — Zombie Prom
Teams made up of pumpkin carvers, cake decorators and sugar artists battle to create Halloween-themed displays depicting a zombie prom.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S03 E02 — Twisted Nursery Rhymes
The four remaining teams battle to create Halloween themed displays of their own version of a fairytale; the celebrity judge is horror movie actor Tony Todd.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S03 E03 — Swamp Creatures Attack
The three remaining teams battle to create Halloween themed displays that capture what happens when swamp creatures attack.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S03 E04 — Nightmares
The two remaining teams battle to create Halloween themed displays that capture nightmares; special guest judge, horror actor Derek Mears.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S04 E01 — The Haunted Farm
Five teams battle to create Halloween themed displays that capture a haunted farm; with special guest judge, Naomi Grossman.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S04 E02 — Don't Go Into the Forest
The four remaining teams create displays that evoke the dire warning; whatever you do, don't go into the forest; with special guest judge, film producer Adi Shankar.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S04 E03 — Mummies vs. Werewolves
The three remaining teams compete to create a Halloween display capturing a battle between mummies and werewolves; guest judge Francia Raisa.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S04 E04 — Haunted Carnival
In the final teams battle to create a display that captures the twisted, demonic world of a haunted carnival; horror actor Lew Temple is the special guest judge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S05 E01 — Infestation
Five teams made up of a pumpkin carver, cake decorator, and sugar artist compete to create Halloween-themed displays that capture an infestation.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S05 E02 — Hybrid Horror
The four remaining teams made up of a pumpkin carver, cake decorator, and sugar artist compete to create Halloween-themed displays that show a mutant hybrid horror.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S05 E03 — Grave Robber
The three remaining teams made up of a pumpkin carver, cake decorator, and sugar artist compete to Halloween-themed displays that capture the horror that follows a grave robbing.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S05 E04 — Undead Dinner Party
For the final battle, two teams made up of a pumpkin carver, cake decorator, and sugar artist must create scream-worthy displays of an undead dinner party.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S06 E01 — Witches vs. Warlocks
Teams made up of a pumpkin carver, cake decorator and sugar artist compete to create displays that capture a clash between witches and warlocks; special guest: Elvira "Mistress of the Dark."

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S06 E02 — Haunted Motel
Five teams compete to create Halloween displays that capture a haunted roadside motel; special guest judge Sid Haig, actor in horror films including "Halloween" and "The Devil's Rejects."

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S06 E03 — Two-Faced
Four remaining teams compete to create Halloween-themed displays that capture the horror of a two-faced monster; Carlson Young, actress from MTV's "Scream," joins the judging panel to help decide which team moves on to the final battle.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S06 E04 — Mausoleum Mayhem
The final three teams attempt to capture the horror that unfolds inside a crypt after dark; joining the judging panel is Greg Plotkin, director of "Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension."

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S06 E05 — Demonic Wedding
Two teams are left, and the team that creates the scariest and most demonic wedding will be crowned champion and win the grand prize; actress Bitsie Tulloch from "Grimm" is the guest judge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S07 E01 — The Hitchhiker's Worst Nightmare
Six teams create Halloween-themed displays that depict what happens when hitchhikers find themselves driving towards disaster after accepting a ride from a stranger.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S07 E02 — Secret Creature Reveal
Five remaining teams create Halloween-themed displays that show the hideous monsters that disguise themselves with normal, human faces.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S07 E03 — Monster Party
Four remaining teams made up of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist go into battle to create Halloween-themed displays that capture what happens when all the monsters throw their own ghastly Halloween party.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S07 E04 — Zombie Cooking Show
The final three teams create Halloween-themed displays that imagine what happens when an undead ghoul hosts their own zombie cooking show.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S07 E05 — Beware
It's the spine-tingling finale of Halloween Wars; the final two teams made up of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist have slaughtered their competition and must face off in one last showdown.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Hayride of Horror: The Scarecrow Comes Alive!
Combining cake, sugar and carved pumpkin to show what happens when scarecrows come alive; the team that gives a wagon full of hay riders the biggest scare will take home $15,000.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Hayride of Horror: When Pumpkins Fight Back
Combining cake, sugar and carved pumpkin to show what happens when the pumpkins they're carving come to life, turn the tables and take revenge on the unlucky carvers; in the end, one team walks away with $15,000.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Hayride of Horror: Possessed Zoo
To win the Hayride of Horror Battle, two teams combine cake, sugar and carved pumpkin to show how to survive a night escaping the demonic inhabitants of a possessed zoo.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Road to Halloween Wars Season 8
More Halloween warriors look to join the battle; 18 of the best pumpkin carvers and cake and sugar artists in the world.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S08 E01 — The Boogeyman's Nightmare
Six teams, each consisting of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar master, dive into the first battle of the season; they have to create displays that depict a monstrous creature so scary that it's the Boogeyman's nightmare.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Even More Monstrous Scares
Digging up even more creepy ghosts, scary witches, werewolves, sweet treats, and creative displays in the history of "Halloween Wars."

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S08 E02 — Clowns vs. Zombies
Five remaining teams go into battle to create Halloween-themed displays that depict a face-off between clowns and zombies; special guest judge John Kassir, voice of the Crypt Keeper on the TV series "Tales from the Crypt."

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S08 E03 — Witch Gets a New Ride
Four teams put their skills to the test to create displays that show what happens when a witch trades in her tired old broom for a brand-new ride; writer, director and producer Mick Garris of the film "Hocus Pocus" joins the judges.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S08 E04 — Halloween Time Travel
The remaining teams pull out all the stops to create scrumptious Halloween-themed displays that bend time and space to show their vision of Halloween time travel; "Stranger Things" actor Gaten Matarazzo serves as guest judge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S08 E05 — Outbreak!
The final two teams face off in one last showdown; the team that can best illustrate a worldwide outbreak and the race for an antidote will be crowned the champions; actress and horror culture personality LeeAnna Vamp serves as guest judge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Road to Halloween Wars 2023
Skilled artists vie for a spot in the Halloween cake competition.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S09 E01 — Trapped in a Nightmare
Six teams create Halloween-themed displays that depict the horror of being trapped in a nightmare and unable to wake up.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S09 E02 — Zombie Dating Show
Five teams create Halloween-themed displays that mix fear and romance in a depiction of a zombie dating show.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S09 E03 — The Swarm
Four teams made up of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist go into battle to imagine a display that terrifies: an attack by a swarm.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S09 E04 — Other Holiday Mascots Go Trick-or-Treating
The teams create Halloween-themed edible displays that show how holiday mascots like Santa and the Easter Bunny go trick-or-treating.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S09 E05 — Scary Tales II
The final two teams, made up of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist, face off in a Halloween showdown; actor Caleb McLaughlin ("Stranger Things") serves as a guest judge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Road to Halloween Wars 2020
Eighteen creative pumpkin carvers and cake and sugar artists are looking to join the battle; they all hope they have what it takes to be chosen to compete.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S10 E01 — Monster Road Trip
Six teams consisting of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist dive into the first challenge: creating spooky displays of Halloween haunts taking a monster road trip; actor Jeremy Ray Taylor guest judges.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S10 E02 — Blind Date From Hell
The five remaining teams of a pumpkin carver, a cake artist and a sugar artist, face the challenge of showing there's nothing scarier than dating as they create their visions of a blind date; Guillermo Diaz joins the judging panel.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S10 E03 — Monster Support Group
The four remaining teams face the challenge of creating Halloween-themed displays showing that even monsters need friends, too; actress Katie Sarife joins the judges to pick the winning team.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S10 E04 — Trapped With a Monster
The three teams receive the tasked of creating Halloween-themed displays showing the claustrophobic terror that results when someone is trapped with a monster; actress Jocelin Donahue joins the judges to choose the final two teams.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S10 E05 — Look Out!
In the final challenge, the team that best captures the terror and fun of horror movie jump scare moments will become the champions.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E01 — Possessed Toys
With the possessed doll at Zak Bagans' The Haunted Museum as inspiration, four teams of cake and sugar artists create spooky cakes to impress judges Eddie Jackson, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E02 — Addams Family Dream Vacation
The Addams Family enjoys a dream vacation with some of the monsters in the world; four teams compete to impress judges Eddie Jackson, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira with their creepy and kooky cakes inspired by the animated film.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E03 — Frightening Folklore
Six teams sculpt cakes based on stories of ghosts and ghouls from around the world; inspired by Zak Bagans' Dybbuk Box, considered an actual haunted item, the cake and sugar artists face a challenging test.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E04 — Spine-Chilling Circus
Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans taunts the five remaining teams with one of the exhibits at his museum: the Circus Room; for this challenge, the cake and sugar artists must show the true terror of the traveling circus.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E05 — Don't Go in the Basement
There's a noise in the basement, and everyone is too afraid to peek until now; Zak Bagans challenges the four remaining teams to imagine what lurks in the dark corners of the basement and bring their visions to life in creepy cakes.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E06 — A Vampire's Vanity
Inspired by a haunted mirror that Zak Bagans acquired from an actor who played Count Dracula, the three remaining teams' challenge is to depict in cake the hobbies a night-stalking vampire might have picked up after hundreds of years of immortality.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S11 E07 — Dueling Monsters
The final two teams go head-to-head for the $25,000 prize as they craft cakes that show what happens when two monsters square off in a duel.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E01 — That Voodoo That You Do
In the first of three qualifying rounds, Eddie Jackson introduces three teams to the haunted city of New Orleans, where they must cast a sweet spell with the voodoo queen, Marie Laveau, to impress the judges.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E02 — Monsters of London
Eddie Jackson shares the haunted Hellfire Caves in London and the monsters that haunt them; the three teams create Halloween-themed displays, and the judges send two more teams to the next round.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E03 — Escape From Alcatraz
Eddie Jackson asks three teams to imagine a monster prison escape inspired by Alcatraz, and the judges decide which teams will escape to the next round.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E04 — A Coven of Confections
Six teams face off for the first time in the main competition, hoping to impress the judges; Eddie introduces them to the haunted city of Salem, Mass., and a coven of witches that is looking for revenge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E05 — All Dolled Up
Eddie introduces the five remaining teams to The Island of the Dolls in Mexico City and the competitors tackle another challenge.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E06 — Boos and Booze
Eddie challenges the four remaining teams to conjure up a ghostly rave party inspired by the haunted Shanghai Tunnels of Portland, Ore.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E07 — Killer Waves
Three teams battle it out in the rough waters of the semifinals as Eddie asks them to dive deep into their fears, taking inspiration from the dark and haunted sea that surrounds Cape Disappointment in Washington.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S12 E08 — Dressed to Kill
The final teams face off in a decisive showdown as Zak Bagans takes them to the haunted catacombs in Paris; host Eddie Jackson and fellow judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown a winner to claim the title of "Halloween Wars" champions.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Road to Halloween Wars 2022
The search is on for cake, sugar and pumpkin artists who can handle challenges created by paranormal investigator Zak Bagans; competitors from across America show off their skills and try to prove that they have what it takes to claim the prize.

title: Halloween's Most Extreme
description: The best of what Halloween has to offer.

title: Halloween Crazy
description: The hosts shed light on the creative masterminds who transform ordinary spaces and materials into the spookiest Halloween exhibitions across the United States.

title: Halloween Craziest
description: America's scariest haunted houses in San Diego; coffin race in Colorado; the ultimate custom body painting studio.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E01 — It's Alive!
The bakers design cakes with a dead-to-alive theme, mixing ingredients that are dead and dark with those that are alive and colorful; one competitor's cake is deemed dead on arrival; the remaining three bakers head home to create their showstoppers.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E02 — Cursed!
The four competing bakers must beware of evil spells as Duff Goldman provides cursed ingredients like blood oranges, black garlic and forbidden rice in the first round challenge.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E03 — Infestation!
A swarm of creepy crawlies is on the menu as Duff Goldman challenges the bakers to create cakes that have become infested and decayed.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E04 — Monster Wedding!
Duff Goldman officiates the monster of all wedding cake competitions as the bakers create cakes fit for monstrous matrimony; following an elimination, the remaining three competitors return to their home bakeries to craft monster-sized cakes.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
Spooky Cakes
Duff Goldman welcomes talented bakers to an unconventional baking and design competition; in the first challenge, the four bakers must create Halloween-themed cakes that incorporate a surprise selection of candies and treats.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E01 — Trick or Treats
In the first challenge, the bakers battle it out to create the best creepy cupcakes; the second challenge consists of classic costume desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E02 — Monster Mashups
The bakers spook the judges with their sculpted scary treats and then mash up flavors and themes to create devilishly delicious desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — Field of Screams
The remaining five bakers whip up creepy, dangerous donuts; in the main challenge, the bakers dig deep to create graveyard pumpkin desserts that are to die for.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — Haunted House Party
The final four bakers bake it out in a haunted house cake battle.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E01 — Monsters, Monsters, Monsters
Seven bakers must create creepy bite-sized monster treats; in the main heat, zombies attack as the bakers try to whip up a zombie dessert that makes the judges hungry for a bite.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E02 — Cravings From the Grave
Six remaining bakers must make a Halloween mummy dessert using pre-made pie dough; the bakers must create a candy-stuffed, wicked cake based on a Halloween icon.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E03 — Haunted Circus
Things get spookier when the five bakers left in the competition must head to the haunted circus to create a dozen scary clown cake pops; the bakers make frighteningly strange mash-up desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E04 — Spirits Rising
The four remaining bakers create tomb-themed desserts; the bakers make a dessert inspired by the colorful artistry and spirit of Mexico's Día de los Muertos, or Day of the Dead; the winners move on to the Halloween Baking Championship finale.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E05 — Ginger Dead House
The final three bakers must fill a haunted tree with decorated Halloween cookies; the bakers have just six hours to construct a spooky ginger dead house; special guest Duff Goldman stops by; the baker with the most impressive house wins $25,000.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E01 — Filled With Surprises
Eight bakers show off their decorating skills by creating Halloween candy-filled cookies; for the main heat, it's oozy fun with sublime slime desserts where bakers can make any treat, but it must be filled with a gooey slime.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E02 — Bewitching Treats
Seven remaining bakers must make witches' fingers and toes and create a sauce to dip them in; the witch theme goes a step further in the main heat when the bakers must create desserts that look like witches, complete with edible brooms.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E03 — It's All In Your Head
Bakers work in teams and put their minds together to create the most outrageous and delicious left brain/right brain desserts; in the main heat, the bakers face their fears by using common phobias like insects and ghosts as inspirations for desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E04 — Sweet Screams
Five remaining bakers take a light, sweet and utterly harmless dessert and head to the dark side; it's a main heat filled with frights as the bakers make scary mask desserts to spook the judges; one baker is eliminated at the end of the round.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E05 — The Candyman Cometh
Four remaining bakers attempt to make desserts that taste like their favorite candy bars; bakers must create a dessert that combines chocolate with odd ingredients; one baker is eliminated.
